summary: A 1v1 on Quicksilver against the user himself (computer_whisperer, Armada, from E3), which our one Opus 5.5 medium seat (Cortex, from D7) won at 14:57, when a ball of Thugs reached his base and killed his commander. The opening followed Matt's line (lab 0:57, Grunts from 1:29), but the Grunts were kept as pickets on our home spots while his single Pawns raided from 2:02, and nothing of ours crossed the middle until 6:33. Our first push stopped at spot_20 and met five Centurions (895 lost for 270, 7:58-8:32), which then walked through our middle killing four extractors while our soldiers split into eleven small hunts; our extractors fell from 14 at 8:00 to 9-11 for the rest of the game. From 10:00 we led 2.4-19x on what we saw, and the player ordered the base push at 10:37 and 11:37, but the hands held it for about two minutes and it reached E3 only at 14:50. Once there it took his E3 economy and his commander within a minute; his factory was never seen.

root.what: The game stayed winnable throughout; 2:00-4:00 is where it left the short path. The first window (2.1-2.4x his army as seen) ended at 4:00 with none of our army in his half. The brief's Quicksilver guard rule kept the Grunts as pickets on our own spots, and the first unit of ours crossed at 6:33. Meanwhile he raided our home spots with single Pawns from 2:02 and expanded unseen: 14 winds at E3, extractors at C1 and G3 by 7:22. This is the reader's reading, measured against the players' rule (L-raid-first-handful) and the user's K-open-early-pawn-pressure-is-standard; nobody commented on this game.

their_play: The user (Armada) opened a bot lab and sent single Pawns at our home spots from 1:50: the D7 extractor at 2:02, then the D6 extractor and a constructor from 3:07 to 3:27. He raided with Pawns all game (8 of our 17 extractor losses). At 7:54 he brought five Centurions down the middle. They broke our Grunt push at spot_20, then walked D4-E5-E6 killing four extractors and turrets (8:03-9:36). Behind that he expanded unseen: 14 wind turbines at E3 and extractors at C1 and G3 by 7:22, plus a nano turret and a radar at E3. From 10:58 to 11:42 fifteen Pawns raided our east and took four extractors, while two Centurions hit spot_23. A Construction Aircraft (armca, his first air unit, 11:01) implies an air plant, but no combat aircraft were seen. From 13:11 to 13:49 two Centurions kited our 28-Thug ball at spot_21/25 (980 lost for 270). No tier 2 was seen, and his factory was never in our picture. His commander stayed at E3 (seen 6:46 and 14:52) and died there at 14:57.

bears_on.note: Nothing of ours crossed until 6:33. His single Pawns were on our spots from 2:02, and his expansion (14 winds at E3, C1, G3) went unseen until 7:22. The rule was relayed the same night, after player-45.
The 10:00-14:00 lead (2.4-19.1x seen) ended the game within a minute of reaching E3 (14:52 to 14:57). Each minute it stood in our half cost extractors (down to 8 at 13:43).
At 9:34 our soldiers were split into eleven groups of one or two and lost the middle. The winning push was one body of 27-29 Thugs.
The order 'When his commander is in sight, group_N1 attacks it with the whole group' stood from 11:37 to 14:37. His commander died at E3 at 14:57.
From his side: five Centurions kept walking D4-E5-E6 (8:03-9:36), killing four extractors, and were not caught until 10:21.
On Quicksilver against a Pawn raider, we had seven constructors by 8:00 and lost 17 extractors; the lobby players said 'more grunts' and '2 cons is very gready on this map'.
The commander assisted the lab (assist4 93 s), but with only three winds the assist emptied the energy store at 1:20.

lens.caveats: There is no truth file (a game with a person), so his numbers are sightings and floors and the army ratios overstate our lead. The game has no chat lines, no ledger row and no review, so nothing a person said about it exists. Every 'because' here is the reader's reading, except where it cites lessons and the human-12 row. The record predates the end row and has no result: the win is inferred from his commander's enemy_destroyed at 14:57 and his structures dying with nothing of ours near at 14:59-15:01. analyze_match.py fails on the batch directory ('no record-*.jsonl') and was run on 00/. pro_baseline.py was not run (Comet only; Quicksilver has no cards); K-open-matt-order-timings was used instead. The binary's commit is not recorded.

What were his real army and economy? With no truth file, only the engine's demo (not read) can say whether the 5.7-20.5x and 15.7-19.1x windows were real.
Would Grunts sent across at 2:00-3:00 have paid against a person's Pawns, given that a Pawn beats a Grunt one against one?
What killed the four Thugs at E3 at 14:52-14:55 'to something unseen' before his commander died? (The 14:57 deaths fit the commander's death blast, 350 radius, 5,000 damage.)
Human-13 has no ledger row, so the main session never read this game. Did the user say anything about it outside the game chat?
